curriculum: The OER identifies an ordinary Mathematics major of 135 EC and a separate Mathematics and Applications programme. This generic target uses the ordinary degree. Nine compulsory 7.5 EC courses and the 15 EC thesis total 82.5 EC. ODE/PDE Modelling is the selected 7.5 EC modelling course. Discrete Mathematics and Differential Equations total 15 EC restricted choice. The 30 EC mathematics choices are Mathematics Laboratory, Numerical Mathematics, Multivariable Analysis and Differentiable Manifolds. The regulation permits Numerical Mathematics as a further mathematics choice when it is not counted in restricted choice. The remaining 45 EC are genuine profiling, with at least 15 EC at level 2 or 3. The chosen major contains 37.5 EC at level 3 (modelling, discrete mathematics, manifolds and thesis), above the 30 EC minimum. The first year is mainly Dutch, with transition toward English in the later years.
progression: Year one pairs proofs with calculus and linear algebra in period 1, then the second calculus and linear algebra course with programming in period 2. Analysis and Mathematics Laboratory are in period 3, with groups and rings and probability in period 4. The 2026 planner lists the follow-on multivariable introduction in Year 2 period 1, topology in period 2, Differential Equations and Numerical Mathematics in period 3, and Multivariable Analysis in period 4. Differential Equations uses the prior calculus and analysis; Numerical Mathematics uses prior calculus and linear algebra. Their programme slots B and A are distinct. Year 2 has 37.5 EC of selected courses plus 22.5 EC profiling. Year 3 places Manifolds (slot A) and ODE/PDE Modelling (slot D) together in period 1 after the relevant preparation, Discrete Mathematics in period 3 and the thesis in the second semester after the main mathematics sequence. The thesis guidance provides both semester windows and asks for enough major preparation for advanced work. Year 3 has 37.5 EC of selected courses plus 22.5 EC profiling. The year-three sequence follows the current period pattern with future offerings subject to actual schedules.
